lines: Under a thousand followers? This pays you anyway.
It's called UGC. Brands pay you to make videos for their own page, so your follower count doesn't matter.
A typical brief: one thirty-second video. Beginners often get fifty to a hundred and fifty dollars.
Great for beauty, food and tech creators. The catch? You need three sample videos before brands say yes.
Send this to a creator friend, and follow for one income stream every day.
